page.title: 比較で“一番”や言い換え

analysis.summaryJa: 比較級を使って実質的な最上級を表す「比較級＋than any other」、二つの説明のうち適切な方を選ぶ「more A than B」、Bと同様にAではないと強く否定する「no more A than B」、Aの程度が低いことを示す「less A than B」の4パターンを扱う。
grammarPoints: 比較級＋than any other＋単数名詞で同一集団内の実質一番を表す
more A than BでBよりAという描写が的確だと示す
no more A than BでBと同様Aではないと否定する
less A than BでAの程度が比較対象より低いと示す
any otherで比較する本人・対象を集団から除外する
visualEvidence: 優勝台をのぞくレンズがthan any other＝ほか全部よりを示す
二つの説明札を比べるレンズがmore A than Bを示す
コンパスとスプーンを同列に置くレンズがno more A than Bの否定を示す
低い危険度メーターがless A than Bを示す
any otherは本人を除くという人物集合のミニ確認
commonTraps: 同一集団でany otherではなくanyを使い本人まで含める
any otherの後ろを複数形にする
more A than Bを単純な数量比較と誤解する
no more A than BをAが少しは当てはまると解釈する
lessの後ろに比較級を重ねる

questions.prompt: Nora handled more client calls than ------- representative on her team.
questions.translationJa: ノラはチームのほかのどの担当者より多くの顧客電話を処理しました。
questions.explanationJa: 同じチーム内で本人を除くためany other＋単数名詞を使います。

questions.prompt: The workshop was more practical ------- theoretical, with several hands-on exercises.
questions.translationJa: その研修は理論的というより実践的で、実習がいくつもありました。
questions.explanationJa: more A than Bが二つの性質のうちAの方が的確だと示します。

questions.prompt: This unsigned note is no more a contract ------- an advertisement is.
questions.translationJa: この署名のないメモは、広告が契約書でないのと同様、契約書ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: no more A than BはBと同様にAではないという強い否定です。

questions.prompt: The revised route is ------- congested than the highway during rush hour.
questions.translationJa: 改訂された経路はラッシュ時の高速道路ほど混雑していません。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞congestedの程度が低いことをless congested thanで示します。

questions.prompt: This branch completed the inventory faster than ------- branch in the region.
questions.translationJa: この支店は地域のほかのどの支店より速く棚卸しを終えました。
questions.explanationJa: 比較主体もregion内の一支店なので、本人を除くany other branchが必要です。

questions.prompt: The manager’s reply sounded more cautious ------- negative.
questions.translationJa: 部長の返答は否定的というより慎重に聞こえました。
questions.explanationJa: more cautious than negativeは、より的確な描写を選びます。

questions.prompt: The empty spreadsheet is no more a report ------- a blank page is.
questions.translationJa: 空の表計算シートは、白紙が報告書でないのと同様、報告書ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 二つともreportではないことをno more ... thanで強く表します。

questions.prompt: The online form is ------- confusing than the paper version.
questions.translationJa: オンライン用紙は紙版ほど分かりにくくありません。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞confusingの低い程度はless confusing thanで表します。

questions.prompt: Aya received higher satisfaction scores than ------- agent at the center.
questions.translationJa: アヤはセンターのほかのどの担当者より高い満足度評価を得ました。
questions.explanationJa: Aya自身を比較集合から除くany other agentが必要です。

questions.prompt: The delay was less costly ------- the supplier had initially predicted.
questions.translationJa: 遅延による費用は仕入先の当初予測ほど高くありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: less costlyの比較基準となる節をthanで導きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying the top seller in one group.

choices.A: Evan sold more subscriptions than any salesperson in the office.
choices.B: Evan sold more subscriptions than any other salesperson in the office.
choices.C: Evan sold most subscriptions than any other salespeople in the office.
choices.D: Evan sold more subscriptions than any others salesperson in the office.

questions.translationJa: エバンはオフィスのほかのどの販売員より多くの購読契約を取りました。
questions.explanationJa: 同じ集団の本人を除くany other＋単数名詞が正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence choosing the better description.

choices.A: The change was administrative more than technically.
choices.B: The change was most administrative than technical.
choices.C: The change was more administrative as technical.
choices.D: The change was more administrative than technical.

questions.translationJa: その変更は技術的というより事務的なものでした。
questions.explanationJa: more A than Bで二つの形容詞を釣り合いよく対比します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence making an emphatic denial.

choices.A: That rumor is no more evidence than a guess is.
choices.B: That rumor is no more evidence as a guess is.
choices.C: That rumor is not evidence more than a guess.
choices.D: That rumor is no most evidence than a guess is.

questions.translationJa: そのうわさは、推測が証拠でないのと同様、証拠ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: no more A than Bの完全な形で両方を否定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing lower difficulty.

choices.A: The online procedure is lesser complicated than the postal procedure.
choices.B: The online procedure is less more complicated than the postal procedure.
choices.C: The online procedure is less complicated than the postal procedure.
choices.D: The online procedure is least complicated than the postal procedure.

questions.translationJa: オンライン手続きは郵送手続きほど複雑ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: less＋原級形容詞＋thanが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing stores within one chain.

choices.A: This outlet attracts more weekend visitors than any outlet in the chain.
choices.B: This outlet attracts most weekend visitors than any other outlets.
choices.C: This outlet attracts more weekend visitors as any other outlet.
choices.D: This outlet attracts more weekend visitors than any other outlet in the chain.

questions.translationJa: この店舗はチェーン内のほかのどの店舗より週末の来店者を集めます。
questions.explanationJa: 比較主体を除外するany other outletを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence clarifying an impression.

choices.A: Her question was curiouser than critical.
choices.B: Her question was more curious than critical.
choices.C: Her question was more curiously than critical.
choices.D: Her question was more curious as critical.

questions.translationJa: 彼女の質問は批判的というより好奇心からのものでした。
questions.explanationJa: 同じ品詞のcuriousとcriticalをmore ... thanで対比します。
questions.focus: more A than Bの品詞対応

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence denying that an object has a function.

choices.A: This sample badge is not more an access pass than the brochure.
choices.B: This sample badge is no access pass more than the brochure is.
choices.C: This sample badge is no more an access pass than the brochure is.
choices.D: This sample badge is no more an access pass as the brochure is.

questions.translationJa: この見本バッジは、パンフレットが入館証でないのと同様、入館証ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: no more A than Bで両方ともaccess passではないと断定します。
questions.focus: no more A than Bの否定

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing two levels of risk.

choices.A: The indoor demonstration is less risky than the outdoor test.
choices.B: The indoor demonstration is fewer risky than the outdoor test.
choices.C: The indoor demonstration is less riskier than the outdoor test.
choices.D: The indoor demonstration is least risky than the outdoor test.

questions.translationJa: 屋内実演は屋外試験ほど危険ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: lessの後ろは形容詞の原級riskyです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying the quickest response.

choices.A: Mina replied sooner than any member of the committee.
choices.B: Mina replied soonest than any other members of the committee.
choices.C: Mina replied more soon than another member of the committee.
choices.D: Mina replied sooner than any other member of the committee.

questions.translationJa: ミナは委員会のほかのどの委員より早く返信しました。
questions.explanationJa: 同じ委員会内のMinaを除くany other memberが実質一番を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing two descriptions of a meeting.

choices.A: The discussion was lesser hostile than it first appeared.
choices.B: The discussion was less more hostile as it first appeared.
choices.C: The discussion was less hostile than it first appeared.
choices.D: The discussion was least hostile than it first appeared.

questions.translationJa: 議論は当初見えたほど険悪ではありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: less hostile than＋節で見かけより程度が低いことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Lena is more experienced than any other technician here."

choices.A: Every technician here is as experienced as Lena.
choices.B: Lena works somewhere other than this office.
choices.C: One other technician is more experienced than Lena.
choices.D: Lena is the most experienced technician here.

questions.translationJa: レナはここで最も経験豊富な技術者です。
questions.explanationJa: 同一集団で比較級＋than any otherは実質的な最上級です。
questions.focus: 比較級と最上級の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The assignment was more tedious than difficult."

choices.A: The assignment was both impossible and exciting.
choices.B: The assignment was mainly tiresome, not especially hard.
choices.C: Difficulty was its only notable feature.
choices.D: The assignment was easier because it was short.

questions.translationJa: その課題は特に難しいというより、主に退屈で骨の折れるものでした。
questions.explanationJa: more A than BはBよりAという描写が適切だと示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This sketch is no more a blueprint than that memo is."

choices.B: Only the memo is a blueprint.
choices.C: Neither the sketch nor the memo is a blueprint.
choices.D: The sketch is closer to a blueprint than the memo.

questions.translationJa: そのスケッチもメモも設計図ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: no more A than BはBがAでないのと同様に主語もAでないという意味です。
questions.focus: no more A than Bの言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The revised plan is less expensive than the original."

choices.A: The original plan costs more than the revised plan.
choices.B: Both plans have the same cost.
choices.C: The revised plan is the least expensive of five.
choices.D: The original plan has already been canceled.

questions.translationJa: 元の計画は改訂案より費用がかかります。
questions.explanationJa: less expensiveの比較方向を逆にするとcosts moreになります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This tower is taller than any other building in the district."

choices.A: The tower is outside the district.
choices.B: This tower is the tallest building in the district.
choices.C: Every building is as tall as the tower.
choices.D: Another building in the district is taller.

questions.translationJa: この塔は地区で最も高い建物です。
questions.explanationJa: any otherが塔自身を除くため、ほか全てを上回る最上級の意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "His tone was more disappointed than angry."

choices.A: He was equally angry and disappointed.
choices.B: His tone made other people angry.
choices.C: He tried to hide every emotion.
choices.D: Disappointment described his tone better than anger did.

questions.translationJa: 彼の口調は怒りより落胆と表現する方が適切でした。
questions.explanationJa: more A than Bは程度の単純比較ではなく、より適切な描写を選びます。
questions.focus: 描写選択のmore A than B

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The label is no more a guarantee than the box is."

choices.A: The label and the box provide no guarantee.
choices.C: The box offers a stronger guarantee.

questions.translationJa: ラベルも箱も保証にはなりません。
questions.explanationJa: no more ... thanは両者を同じく否定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Video calls are less formal than board meetings."

choices.A: Video calls are the least formal event.
choices.B: Both types of meeting are equally formal.
choices.C: Board meetings are more formal than video calls.
choices.D: Board meetings are shorter than video calls.

questions.translationJa: 取締役会議はビデオ通話より正式です。
questions.explanationJa: 比較対象を入れ替え、less formalをmore formalにすると同じ関係です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Omar processed more claims than any other clerk."

choices.A: No other clerk processed as many claims as Omar.
choices.B: Every clerk processed more claims than Omar.
choices.C: Omar processed claims for another office only.
choices.D: One clerk matched Omar’s total exactly.

questions.translationJa: オマールほど多くの請求を処理したほかの担当者はいません。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級＋any otherはNo other ... as many asで言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The situation is less urgent than we assumed."

choices.A: The situation has become more urgent.
choices.B: We overestimated the urgency of the situation.
choices.D: No one considered the situation urgent.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは状況の緊急度を実際より高く見積もっていました。
questions.explanationJa: 実際が想定よりless urgentなら、想定は緊急度を過大評価していました。

questions.prompt: All twelve account managers submitted sales totals. Priya reported higher revenue than ------- manager in the division.
questions.translationJa: 12人の顧客担当者全員が売上額を提出しました。プリヤは部署のほかのどの担当者より高い売上を報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: Priyaもdivisionの一員なのでany other managerで本人を除きます。

questions.prompt: The proposal contains few technical details but many scheduling rules. It is more administrative ------- technical.
questions.translationJa: 提案書には技術的詳細が少なく、日程規則が多く含まれます。技術的というより事務的です。
questions.explanationJa: 内容からadministrativeの方が的確なのでmore A than Bを使います。

questions.prompt: A visitor badge does not unlock any door. This printed sample is no more an access card ------- the visitor badge is.
questions.translationJa: 来訪者バッジではどの扉も開きません。この印刷見本もそのバッジ同様、入館カードではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 両方ともaccess cardでないことをno more ... thanで示します。

questions.prompt: The north route avoids two construction zones. It is ------- likely to be delayed than the central route.
questions.translationJa: 北側ルートは2か所の工事区域を避けます。中央ルートより遅延する可能性が低いです。
questions.explanationJa: 可能性の程度が低いのでless likely thanが適切です。

questions.prompt: The chain has eight cafés. The station café serves more morning customers than ------- café in the chain.
questions.translationJa: そのチェーンには8店のカフェがあります。駅前店はチェーンのほかのどの店より朝の客が多いです。
questions.explanationJa: 同じチェーン内で駅前店自身を除くany other caféを使います。

questions.prompt: The client did not reject the idea; she only asked for more data. Her response was more cautious ------- negative.
questions.translationJa: 顧客は案を拒否せず、追加データを求めただけでした。返答は否定的というより慎重でした。
questions.explanationJa: 前文からcautiousの方が適切な描写だと分かります。

questions.prompt: The draft contains no prices, dates, or signatures. It is no more a contract ------- a shopping list is.
questions.translationJa: 草案には価格、日付、署名がありません。それは買い物リストが契約書でないのと同様、契約書ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: no more a contract thanが両方を契約書ではないと強く否定します。

questions.prompt: The automated check catches most typing errors. As a result, the final review is ------- time-consuming than before.
questions.translationJa: 自動チェックはほとんどの入力ミスを見つけます。その結果、最終確認は以前ほど時間がかかりません。
questions.explanationJa: time-consumingの程度低下をlessで示します。

questions.prompt: Every analyst in the unit took the same certification test. Ken finished sooner than ------- analyst in the unit.
questions.translationJa: 部門の全分析担当者が同じ認定試験を受けました。ケンは部門のほかのどの担当者より早く終えました。
questions.explanationJa: Ken自身を比較対象から外すany other analystが必要です。

questions.prompt: The first estimate assumed premium materials. The updated estimate is ------- costly than we feared.
questions.translationJa: 最初の見積りは高級材料を前提としていました。更新版は懸念していたほど高額ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: costlyの程度が想定より低いのでless costly than節を使います。
